observation.visible_scene: A faceted glass tumbler filled with dark purple liquid sits in a pale rectangular tray on a light wooden tabletop. A metal spoon rests inside the glass toward the left, and a thin wooden stick with a small purple sphere at its lower end stands vertically in the liquid, the stick passing through a slot in a flat piece of cardboard. A right hand grips the glass from the side, while a left hand, mostly at the top edge of the frame, holds the cardboard.
visible_changes: The cardboard starts held horizontally above the rim, then is tilted into a near-vertical position in front of the glass (mid-frames), then lifted completely out of view, then brought back into the top of the frame at an angle with the stick still passing through its slot.
The wooden stick remains upright in the liquid throughout the excerpt, with the purple sphere at its base staying submerged near the center of the glass.
The right hand steadies the glass through the early frames, then releases it and moves out to the right (around frames 15-18 onward), leaving the glass unsupported for the rest of the clip.
The spoon shifts slightly, leaning more upright against the left inner wall as the sequence progresses, but it stays within the liquid.
The tray, glass and wooden background keep fixed positions across all frames, indicating a stationary camera; the visible motion comes from the hands, the cardboard and the spoon.
outside_clip_unknowns: The purpose of the slotted cardboard and the dipping/holding action it performs.
The identity of the purple sphere on the stick and of the liquid.
What occurs before the first frame and after the last frame.
uncertain_details: The exact frame at which the right hand lets go of the glass.
Whether the spoon is being actively moved or simply settling.
Whether the cardboard is being used to position the stick or to lift it.
